objective: Create a deterministic repository-discovery engine that inventories the repository structure, identifies important project boundaries and engineering artifacts, classifies discovered paths, and produces a stable repository discovery report for downstream context and reasoning systems.
architecturalContext: River Development Agent roadmap Generation II
acceptanceCriteria: The agent recursively discovers repository paths without traversing outside the repository boundary.
Excluded and protected repository paths are not traversed as ordinary discovery targets.
Discovered paths are normalized to repository-relative forward-slash paths.
Discovery output is deterministic for the same repository state.
The engine distinguishes files from directories.
The engine classifies important River Dev, source, configuration, documentation, test, content, and infrastructure paths.
The discovery result records repository identity, branch, commit, counts, classifications, and discovery timestamp.
The engine can identify key repository roots and important project files without depending on framework-specific assumptions.
A CLI command produces a readable repository discovery report.
Discovery performs read-only repository analysis and does not modify application files.
Focused tests, River Dev typechecking, and main-project typechecking pass.
